title: Reading the Penalty Still Standing on a Ridgecrest RxSecure Account
content:
The penalty still standing on a Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan account is ordinarily the penalty balance the enrollment carries, but where the enrollment stands in its premium grace period the account's own entries are read instead, and which reading governs turns on how the carried balance compares with the account.

1. Where the penalty balance the enrollment carries is more than the penalty the account has charged less the penalty taken back off it, and the enrollment stands in its premium grace period, the penalty still standing is worked out from the account's own entries as the penalty charged less the penalty taken back off.
2. Where the penalty balance the enrollment carries is less than the penalty the account has charged less the penalty taken back off it, and the enrollment stands in its premium grace period, the penalty still standing is worked out from the account's entries for the 12 months up to the handling date less the penalty taken back off.
3. Where neither holds, the penalty still standing is the penalty balance the enrollment carries.

| The carried penalty balance against the account's charged-less-removed figure | Standing of the enrollment | The penalty still standing |
| --- | --- | --- |
| More than it | in its premium grace period | every penalty charged, less every removal posted |
| Less than it | in its premium grace period | the penalty charged in the 12 months up to the handling date, less every removal posted |
| Equal to it | in its premium grace period | the penalty balance the enrollment carries |
| More than it | in force or any other footing | the penalty balance the enrollment carries |
| Less than it | in force or any other footing | the penalty balance the enrollment carries |

Where the carried balance and the account's charged-less-removed figure agree exactly, neither of the first two rows is met, and the carried balance governs.

## Worked on a hypothetical account

Take an account in its premium grace period on which penalty charges total 26.40 USD since coverage began, of which 17.60 USD falls in the 12 months up to the handling date, and on which removals total 4.40 USD.

- With the enrollment carrying a penalty balance of 30.00 USD, which is more than 26.40 USD less 4.40 USD, the penalty still standing is 22.00 USD.
- With the enrollment carrying a penalty balance of 10.00 USD, which is less than that same figure, the penalty still standing is 17.60 USD less 4.40 USD, that is 13.20 USD.
- With the same account standing in force, the penalty still standing is simply the balance the enrollment carries.
